forcing_schedule: Eisenstat-Walker choice 1: eta_0=0.5; after accepted step s_k, raw eta is abs(||F(x_{k+1})||-||F(x_k)+J_k s_k||)/||F(x_k)||. If eta_k**phi>0.1 (phi=(1+sqrt(5))/2), the next eta is at least eta_k**phi; the result is clamped to [1e-10,0.5]. Each linear solve is accepted only when the true residual ||J_k s_k+F(x_k)||/||F(x_k)|| is at most eta_k.
scope: Experimental one-dimensional full backward-Euler nonlinear-solve measurement. All methods solve the same nonlinear equation to the same residual tolerance.
timing_protocol: One complete nonlinear-solve warmup per method is excluded. Timed methods are rotated by repetition; each solve is synchronized; medians and IQRs include preconditioner rebuilding at every Newton iterate and all GMRES work.
